summary.en: Sudan General Al-Atta says Puntland mercenaries are fighting alongside RSF, while intense clashes continue in Malakal and an ambush on a Warrap road killed five people. A police officer apologized after a viral video of a Juba assault, claiming the victim was a gang member, and the deputy minister of ICT warned against abusing freedom of expression. Communal violence persists, with a school girl killed by an unintentional RPG explosion in Yei and a cleric shot dead in Juba, while peace talks were launched in Tonj East to end deadly communal violence. The UCDP counted 2 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Sudan-general Al-Atta sier at Puntland-leiesoldater kjemper sammen med RSF-militsen, mens intense kamper fortsetter i Malakal og et bakholdsangrep på en vei i Warrap drepte fem personer. En politimann ba om unnskyldning etter en viral video av et angrep i Juba, og hevdet at offeret var medlem av en gjeng, og visedepartementet for IKT advarte mot å misbruke ytringsfriheten. Kommunal vold vedvarer, med en skolejente drept av en utilsiktet RPG-eksplosjon i Yei og en prest skutt død i Juba, mens fredssamtaler ble igangsatt i Tonj East for å få slutt på dødelig kommunal vold. UCDP talte to dødsfall knyttet til kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: South Sudanese Civil War
background.extract: The South Sudanese Civil War was a multi-sided civil war in South Sudan fought from 2013 to 2018 between government and opposition forces. The civil war caused rampant human rights abuses, including forced displacement, ethnic massacres, and killings of journalists by various parties. Since the war's end, South Sudan has been governed by a coalition formed by leaders of the former warring factions, Salva Kiir and Riek Machar. The country continues to recover from the war while experiencing ongoing and systemic ethnic violence.
